membership_contract.D: For mN>c^2 and c>=0, R=J-c iff 4mN+4c+1 is square.
membership_contract.U: For mN>0, A=1 iff mN+1 is square.
membership_contract.scope: These two state subsets only. D membership does not guarantee a square completion gap.
membership_contract.flag: bit 1: D strip membership; bit 2: U boundary membership
membership_contract.power_of_two_omission: For these pairs and odd N, H=1 mod 8, so the D-only 4096 filter is redundant. The U filter retains it.
membership_contract.large_phase_reduction: N is reduced once per modulus inside each candidate call; all 13 pairs reuse those phases.

cost_contract.timed: Complete state-membership calls including each N's modular reductions, candidate construction, roots when admitted, flag comparison and group result creation.
cost_contract.excluded: Imports, source/input checks, expected-state restoration, table lookup/build, initial warmup, instrumentation and serialization.
cost_contract.positive_unit: A 13-member cohort of distinct constructed N with one prescribed pair each; not directly comparable to the public one-N packet.
cost_contract.repetition_scope: Same-process paired warm timing replays, not independent success observations or fresh-process benchmarks.
cost_contract.comparison_scope: Same two state-membership predicates. No claimed factoring speedup or replacement of the full witness API.
